you_should_know.title: Can mining near Minnesota's Boundary Waters be carried out safely?
you_should_know.summary: Gov. Tim Walz's move to ban mining near the Boundary Waters, the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness, lake country on the Canadian border roughly 250 miles north of Minneapolis, highlights a long-standing debate: Can a copper-nickel mine operate in a northern Minnesota watershed without tarnishing the world-class Boundary Waters? The answer depends on who you ask.
